**What happened this run:**

- **probe-day1 failed** after 27 checks. The simulator still had the previous run's Google Analytics proof record, so Google Analytics connected straight away and the "refused without proof" check never fired.
- **probe-day2 failed** because day1 never finished. It never reached the drafting step, so my fix to day2's draft setup (commit `dbb3c94e`) has still not been tested.
- **probe-stack failed** one check (30 passed). I haven't looked at which one yet.
- **Port 8931 was blocked:** a leftover runner from an earlier run of mine was holding it, so the new runner couldn't start.

I stopped the stack, moved the old state aside to `/tmp/t299/old-0835`, restarted everything clean (runner now PID 41871 on :8931), and started all four probes again. Results will be in `/tmp/t299/probes-summary.txt`.
